# dependencytrack_secret (Resource)

Manages a Secret. Requires API version >= 5.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "dependencytrack_secret" "example" {
  name        = "secret-name"
  value       = "secret-value"
  description = "secret-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Secret.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Value of the Secret.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the Secret.

### Read-Only

- `url` (String) Location of the Secret.
